detail: _screen-grants-panel.tsx: replaced read-only max-level Badge with inline per-row Select (VIEW/ADD/EDIT/DELETE from menuApi.actionLevels(), sorted by rank) firing screenAccessApi.updateGrant(id, { action_level }) on change (payload field confirmed as action_level, not max_action_level, from ScreenGrantUpdate in types.ts); disabled when grant.is_locked with FR-25 lock messaging adapted to 'cannot be reduced'; errors surfaced via useToast matching existing revoke pattern; falls back to the original read-only Badge when !canManage or grant revoked. typecheck clean, vitest 4 files/31 tests passed.
